subject: Execution
notes: LANDED kb/Work PB1123. Every verb that stores several operands of ONE statement with no verb-specific timing rule identifies them once, in source order, before the first read or store, through the ONE mechanism PlaceIdentification.Freeze (hoisted by PlaceIdentification.Hoister): UNSTRING (INTO, DELIMITER IN, COUNT IN, POINTER, TALLYING; its MOVE stores rebuilt over the frozen places by BoundMove.Retargeted), STRING (senders, receiver, POINTER), INSPECT, INVOKE (receiver, arguments, RETURNING, universal path) and CALL, whose private hoist copy is deleted in favour of the same mechanism. UNSTRING S INTO I UE(I) stores UE(1), WITH POINTER PE(I) delivers into PE(1).
